|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Adds one battle destiny with Vader (or against a Rebel at a mobile site). Spies and Jar Jar may not deploy to Death Star. May subtract 2 from the Force retrieved from On The Edge or Off The Edge. Once per game, may ▲ Put All Sections On Alert, Hyperwave Scan, or an ISB agent.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds one battle destiny if with Vader (or a Rebel at a mobile site). Jar Jar and opponent’s spies may not deploy to Death Star. Once per game, may take Hyperwave Scan, Put All Sections On Alert, or an ISB agent into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' added “if”; removed “against”; removed “Spies and”; added “and opponent’s spies”; removed “May subtract 2 from the Force retrieved from On The Edge or Off The Edge.”; “▲” → “take Hyperwave Scan,”; removed “Hyperwave Scan,”; “agent.” → “agent into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 27. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Tarkin]].
* Later text: [[Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Tarkin]].
